lines.text: Abimelech and Phicol ask Abraham to swear not to deal falsely with them, and Abraham says he swears it.
Abraham complains about a well Abimelech's servants seized, and Abimelech says he did not hear of it until today.
Abraham gives Abimelech sheep and cattle, and sets apart seven ewe lambs as a witness that he dug the well.
The place is named Bethel, and afterward Abimelech and Phicol return to the land of the Philistines.
Abraham plants a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, calls on the LORD, and then moves on from the land of the Philistines.
